subject: PICTURE clause
notes: LANDED 2026-09-19 (kb/Work PB491). Rule 6's FIRST SENTENCE names four kinds of floating insertion symbol - 'The currency symbol, the extended editing sign control symbols, if specified, and the fixed editing sign control symbols + and -' - and the detector knew only three. PictureComposition.MarkFloating now takes the FOR-phrase character-1 letters as floating candidates (the IS-form ones stay transparent, since rule 3 makes those SIMPLE insertion symbols and rule 6's own 'embedded ... or to the immediate right' sentence is what absorbs them), and CobolEdit's digit-position count, suppression walk, placement pass and mask capacity all follow: a repeated FOR character-1's occurrences are digit positions, the literal lands once at the rightmost suppressed position of its zone, and GR14 sizes it as 'one occurrence of literal-2 or literal-3 ... plus one character for each repetition of character-1'. MEASURED: PIC LLLL9.99F with "(" / ")" renders ' (123.45)' for -123.45, exactly Annex D.24's 'b(123.45)'; PIC LLLL9.99 with "DEBIT " is 13 characters, the size D.24 states outright.
